create_dispatcher_actor: create a Dispatcher actor for a role that acts as a message broker between agents and sinks
enqueue_orchestrator: enqueue an Orchestrator into the Dispatcher's incoming queue for round-robin distribution to agents
submit_processed_orchestrator: submit a processed Orchestrator back to the Dispatcher to forward to the next role or sink
handle_agent_restart: handle agent restart by calling agent_started to tombstone previously checked-out orchestrators
shutdown_dispatcher: shutdown the Dispatcher and signal all registered agents to shut down gracefully
